title: Polar water-equivalent hydrogen (excess over background)
method: WEH = max(H − H_bg, 0) × 9/10⁴ (H mass fraction in H2O = 0.112) with H_bg = 55.6 ppm, the median Lunar Prospector hydrogen between 60°S and 60°N (solar-wind implanted H, not water), weighted by a ramp from 0 at |lat| = 70° to 1 at 80°: outside the polar cold traps excess H is not attributed to water. At 0.5° the signal is diluted: PSR-scale ice (Feldman et al. 2001: ~1.5 wt% WEH) appears as ~0.05–0.1 wt%; combine with sun.psr_mask (T6) to locate the ice. Bilinear resampling of the 0.5° simple-cylindrical product (longitude wraps at ±180°). True footprint ~60–150 km: finer grids add no detail.
